name: hly-codex-guards
description: HLY coding guardrails for requirement clarification, production implementation planning, staged execution planning, bounded Subagent delegation assessment, multi-service and multi-repository task decomposition, logging, Chinese comments, SQL writing, single-risk fixes, and diff-only code review.

interface.shortDescription: HLY planning, Subagent assessment, SQL, review, and fix guardrails
interface.longDescription: Personal Codex guardrails for requirement clarification, production implementation planning, staged execution planning, independent Subagent assessment, multi-service and multi-repository workflow decomposition, bounded delegation when net benefit is clear, shared-semantics ownership by the primary Agent, minimal valuable logging, restrained Chinese code comments, simple maintainable SQL, single-risk fixes, and current-diff-only code review.
defaultPrompt: Use $code-review-guard to review only the current diff.
Use $single-risk-fix to fix one confirmed risk with the smallest change.
Use $requirement-scope-clarification to clarify business scope before design or coding.
Use $subagent-delegation-assessment to assess bounded Subagent delegation for multi-service, multi-repository, or independently decomposable work.
